author: TeIq
content: Plan: (1) Migration 45 adds actioned_at + actioned_by_action_id to reports, partial index on actioned_at IS NULL. (2) Add optional report_id field to SubmitAction DTO (backend + frontend mirror). (3) In submit_action handler, when report_id is Some, open transaction, SELECT FOR UPDATE the report, return existing action if already actioned, else insert action + UPDATE reports. (4) Filter actioned reports in build_case_view and list_by_subject. (5) Frontend report_list.rs passes Some(report.id) for ack/dismiss/escalate (mute is reporter-level so None). (6) Integration test exercising the idempotency path.
